rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials - trees in wells on the shop side, palms alternating on Amber: the avenue's signature (zone 406 -> about 360)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's five builder trees go (a queen palm on Amber by the bench, four broadleaf crowded on the little green at the corner); three come back on their own spots: the Amber palm and two trees of the green.

trees.why: the grass on Amber by the park bench and the bin: the avenue's palm
the little green at the corner, by the bird of paradise and the bougainvillea: its first tree
the same green 11 m east, among the iceplant: its second tree (the two between them crowded it)
